## What We Do

We are tackling one of the biggest challenges in healthcare operations: the false choice between speed and safety. We help organizations scale their networks and accelerate revenue without compromising the rigorous compliance required to protect patients.

Our mission is to rebuild the infrastructure of trust by transitioning the industry from manual task management to a new standard in credentialing, powered by Agentic AI.

Beyond simple automation, our platform is powered by CredAgent®—the industry’s first autonomous agent designed to scale human expertise. Unlike "Black Box" tools, we provide full transparency, connecting directly to  over 3,200 primary source verification types to deliver audit- ready citations, decision logs, and verified results in seconds.

With Verifiable, organizations unlock 10x productivity. Whether utilizing our software, our NCQA-certified CVO, or a hybrid of both, we enable teams to automate their workflows across the entire provider journey—unifying credentialing, enrollment, and monitoring into a single source of truth.

These operational gains come at a critical moment for payers, which face rising cost, regulatory, and administrative pressures and increasingly view AI as a strategic lever. Recent analysis shows that network-focused use cases are among the fastest-growing areas of AI investment, reflecting payer demand to improve provider quality and member access. CredAgent® expands credentialing capacity and improves accuracy without adding staff, helping organizations sustain network growth while supporting compliance and patient safety.
